subject: Licensing and marketplace catalogue questions for Datadog ↔ Grafana connector
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@datadog.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>; datadog-partner-ops@datadog.com
Cc: Marco Rinaldi <marco@grafana.com>
Date: 2027-11-28T09:12:00Z
Subject: Questions for marketplace catalogue + licensing alignment

Hi Priyom —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our partner ops team is working on the Datadog Marketplace listing and had a couple of licensing/packaging questions we hoped Redwood could confirm so we can move the listing forward: 

1) Is the connector offered under your standard hosted usage pricing or do we need a separate commercial SKU when sold through marketplace?
2) Are there any customer-facing limits (concurrent model connections / seats) we should reflect on the marketplace tile?
3) For co-sell listings, do you require a minimum contract term or any reserved capacity commitments?
4) Any public privacy/data flow blurb we can include (ccpa/gdpr bullet)?

We have an internal deadline next Friday to push the catalogue metadata. Attaching the marketplace questionnaire for your legal/commercial team.

Sara
Sara Liu
Partner Programs, Datadog
Attachments: DD_Marketplace_Questionnaire_v3.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@datadog.com>; datadog-partner-ops@datadog.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-28T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Questions for marketplace catalogue + licensing alignment

Hi Sara —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers at a high level — sharing the formal PDF + MAP in this thread for legal/commercial to confirm:

- Pricing SKU: Our hosted API is generally usage-based (per-token / per-embedding). For listings through partner marketplaces we offer an optional reseller SKU (monthly metered seat) when partners want consolidated billing. We can surface both on the tile; choice depends on how Datadog prefers invoicing to the customer.
- Limits to call out: we do not gate by "seats" at the API layer; instead recommend documenting recommended concurrent recommendations (e.g., suggest the customer size GPU/Dedicated if sustained throughput > X tokens/sec). We can provide a short blurb.
- Minimum term / reserved capacity: not required for Marketplace listing. Reserved capacity commitments are available as an upsell (Dedicated) but should not be on the marketplace tile as a prerequisite.
- Privacy blurb: see attached one-liner (we only persist metadata for billing and observability; customer data retention configurable in Private deployments; SOC 2 + CCPA controls listed).

Laura and Ben — can you validate the attached PDF for legal/commercial and the two-line privacy copy? Ben, can you add the recommended sizing note we should publish?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30 min sync if helpful.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_GD_DD_Licensing_Qs.pdf, Redwood_Datadog_Grafana_MAP.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>; Sara Liu <sara.liu@datadog.com>; datadog-partner-ops@datadog.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-29T10:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Questions for marketplace catalogue + licensing alignment

Thanks Priyom. Quick legal/commercial clarifications after an initial pass on the questionnaire: 

- Confirm we can provide both listing options (usage-based tile copy + optional reseller SKU). If Datadog wants to enable consolidated billing, we'll need a PSA with partner ops and a contract addendum. Request: include a 30-day notice period for contract termination in the reseller addendum.
- No minimum term required for marketplace listing; recommended language: "No minimum commitment for hosted usage; optional reserved capacity available."
- Privacy/data flow: we can provide the suggested 1–2 sentence blurb for the tile. We will not reference SOC 2 in tile copy; better to link to compliance page.

Priyom — attaching a marked-up PDF with tracked items. I'll sync with Legal for final sign-off but this is safe to surface to Datadog partner ops while we finalize the addendum.

Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_GD_DD_Licensing_Qs.pdf (annotated)

Hi all — jumping in from Grafana side. A couple of notes specific to the co-sell tile we plan to publish in Grafana Cloud Marketplace: 

- Catalog constraints: tile character limit is tight; we recommend the short privacy blurb and a single "pricing" line with a CTA to a consolidated page for detailed SKUs.
- Compatibility note: please confirm supported Grafana versions and whether the connector requires any specific agent/OTLP proxy config. We'll need a one-line compatibility field.
- Technical assets: if Ben can provide a 1-paragraph "How it works" and one architecture SVG, we can include it on the tile and the docs link.

Proposed next step: 30-minute triage on Tuesday (Dec 1) to confirm final catalogue copy and the reseller addendum checklist. Does that work?

Thanks,
Marco
Partner Integrations, Grafana Labs
